ns2:section.sectionText: Meets with BADM 445 section A. This section is open to students in the MSA, MAS, MSF, and MBA programs. If you are interested in this course and you are not in one of these programs, please contact the instructor via email at jmkurtz@uiuc.edu. Registration in this section will begin at noon on Wednesday, November 12, 2008.
